name: Workspace Names & Icons
author: Jim Burchel
description: Name every workspace and give it an icon, right in the bar. Double-click a workspace to edit it and search 10,000 icons by name. The numbers stay, so Super+3 still goes to 3. No config files to edit.

barWidget.description: Workspace number + name + icon — click to switch, double-click to rename and pick an icon, scroll to cycle
